_doc: Per-plant settings for plants_to_unity.py, keyed by plant name (GLB name without _p1).
front: glTF axis the model's front faces (+X, -X, +Z, -Z). Leave out to auto-detect from the Tripo source image.
glow: parts the shader may light up, as y ranges (0..1) in plants.json. Each part is a rule evaluated on LOD0:
widest_component      y extent of the connected part with the largest x/z extent (a canopy)
small_components      y extent of all small separate parts (< max_share of the faces each), e.g. drops
above_base_component  tallest part, from the top of the widest grounded part (moss base) to its top
bulb_top              from where the horizontal radius first exceeds factor x the thinnest stalk radius, to the top
